addConnection.label: Add a database connection
addConnection.hint: Connect a MySQL, Postgres, or SQL Server database.

run.label: Run a query
run.hint: Type SQL in the editor and press Run (or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter).

explore.label: Explore a table
explore.hint: Double-click a table in the sidebar to browse its data.

ai.label: Ask {assistant}
ai.hint: Insert SQL that {assistant} proposes into your editor.

save.label: Save a query
save.hint: Keep a query you'll reuse for later.
